Rewires and New InstallationsFull and partial rewires for homes, offices, shops and salons, new builds and fuseboard upgrades. Lighting Design and InstallationChandeliers, pendants, downlights, LED strips, garden lighting and high bay lighting for warehouses. Homes, Landlords and Businesses

Most of our work is for commercial business owners, property developers, property managers and estate agents, as well as home owners. Commercial maintenance, rewires and fuseboards are the three things we do most.

Other Work We Take On

We also cover smart home automation, CCTV, home cinema and media room wiring, home office electrical installations, bathroom electrics, extractor fans, smoke and heat alarms, emergency lighting systems, three phase distribution boards, machinery and equipment connections, landlord electrical safety certificates, HMO electrical compliance, portable appliance testing (PAT), thermal imaging inspections, communal area maintenance.
